rationale: Both Shreyas and Hrushikesh work as Supply Chain Analysts with deep expertise in supply chain management, making them natural peers for shop talk and professional insights. Shreyas brings cross-functional experience spanning hospitality, sales, and project management methodologies like Agile and Kanban, while Hrushikesh's focus on healthcare operations offers a different vertical lens on supply chain challenges—creating a complementary learning opportunity despite their similar roles.
intro_message: Shreyas Khatav, meet Hrushikesh Jadhav — you're both Supply Chain Analysts with hands-on operations experience, and comparing notes between Saint Gobain and healthcare supply chain work could yield practical insights for both of you.
